description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'EventBusDeviceConnectionAdapter' that binds a DeviceConnectionService to the Vert.x event bus, handling device connection requests such as getting and setting the last known gateway, with support for OpenTracing spans.

classes.name: EventBusDeviceConnectionAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class that connects DeviceConnectionService to the Vert.x event bus, handling request processing and tracing.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the DeviceConnectionService instance.

methods.name: getEventBusAddress
methods.description: Returns the event bus address for device connection messages.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Processes incoming device connection requests, routing to specific handlers based on operation.

methods.name: processGetLastGatewayRequest
methods.description: Handles 'get last known gateway' requests, including validation, tracing, and service invocation.

methods.name: processSetLastGatewayRequest
methods.description: Handles 'set last known gateway' requests, including validation, tracing, and service invocation.

methods.name: newChildSpan
methods.description: Creates a new OpenTracing span with tags for tenant, device, and gateway IDs.

methods.name: processCustomOperationMessage
methods.description: Handles unsupported custom operations, defaulting to a 400 Bad Request error.
